examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A framed widget, the workloads list, filling a panel the host sizes.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: A framed widget plated as a console window, and the same widget bare, floating on the host surface.

examples.name: Still fragment
examples.summary: The same fragment with its collaborator cursor, as a feature grid shows it, and with `:cursor="false"`, as a product band that reads like a screenshot wants it. Fragments are drawn bare at their own width: `kind`, `chrome`, `width` and `fade` re-plate only the workload screens, and setting them on a fragment warns in development.

examples.name: Library
examples.summary: Every registered widget in the cell that hosts it on the site: full screens in wide panels, fragments in grid cells that play their beat on hover. These are the only values `name` accepts.
